prompted_by: REV's finding that BE's REL_BAR=1e-9 admits ~1.8e-8 absolute where last-ulp noise is ~2e-15 -- 'a delta that large isn't float noise; it's a behavioural change that happened not to cross theta today'
THE_ANSWER: MY DECISION PATH CARRIES NO TOLERANCE AT ALL. Every deciding comparison is EXACT. So there is no REL_BAR of mine to tighten.

BUT_EXACTNESS_IS_NOT_ROBUSTNESS_AND_REVS.with_the_threshold_changed: REV's deciding quantity is occupancy near THETA. Mine is occupancy near ZERO -- the futility predicate asks only whether D crossed zero.
BUT_EXACTNESS_IS_NOT_ROBUSTNESS_AND_REVS.so_the_question_I_must_answer_is_the_sam: how close is the sign decision to flipping on a delta of the size REV measured?

MEASURED.reading: the sign decision sits ~10 ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE from flipping. On the observed scale of D -- thousands of cents -- a float-order delta cannot move it.

BUT_EXACTNESS_IS_NOT_ROBUSTNESS_AND_REVS.AND_THE_LIMIT_ON_THAT_READING: it is measured on the FOUR CONSUMED DAYS. A forward day whose D lands near zero would be fragile in exactly REV's sense, and nothing about today's margins prevents that. The margin must be REPORTED PER DAY, not assumed from these four.

TWO_STRUCTURAL_PROTECTIONS_I_DID_NOT_DES.the_p_value_is_QUANTIZED: p = (1+k)/501, so it can only take values on a grid 0.001996 wide. The nearest attainable values either side of 0.025 are 0.023952 and 0.025948 -- MINIMUM distance 0.000948. A p-value CANNOT sit near its threshold; no float delta of any plausible size reaches it.
TWO_STRUCTURAL_PROTECTIONS_I_DID_NOT_DES.the_floor_comparisons_are_dyadic: day_sign_p(G,G) is 2/2^G -- exactly representable. At G=7, 0.015625 vs 0.025 is 4.26e13 ulps of margin.
TWO_STRUCTURAL_PROTECTIONS_I_DID_NOT_DES.why_this_matters: the fragile comparison in this design is the SIGN OF D, and only that one. Holm and the floor are protected by quantization and exact representation respectively.

WHAT_I_AM_NOT_DOING_AND_WHY.not_adding_a_tolerance: a tolerance on `D <= 0` would CREATE the ambiguity REV is objecting to -- it would let a real behavioural change be absorbed as noise. Exact comparison plus a reported margin is strictly better than a tolerance.
WHAT_I_AM_NOT_DOING_AND_WHY.NOT_MODIFYING_THE_EVALUATOR_AT_ALL: it is byte-identical to 7ed5a90 (7c137ddc2d8869b5) and I certified that an hour ago. Any edit breaks the provenance I just established and moves the declared pipeline commit. The per-day margin is computable BESIDE the emit without touching the module -- and that is how I will report it.
WHAT_I_AM_NOT_DOING_AND_WHY.if_the_coordinator_wants_it_IN_the_modul: that is a ruling, like the renames, and it lands after the last forward book.

WHAT_THE_DAY_ONE_EMIT_WILL_CARRY: the per-day line: D, p, n, base, arm
the FUTILITY verdict naming the day and its cause
the attainable minimum p at the G achieved so far
the TOLERANCE at that G (0 at the ruled G=7 -- all seven days must be positive)
the pipeline-provenance limit, because DA's RESULT_DOES_NOT_STATE_ITS_PIPELINE_PROVENANCE_LIMIT refuses an emit that omits it and I will not work around that refusal
and NEW, from this audit: the margin |D| to zero beside the sign decision, so the fragility is reported rather than assumed
REV_173_NOTED: no comparator result can make the waiver available; sufficiency for a FORWARD day needs a per-book guard because the deciding quantity is that day's own occupancy near theta. My valuation expects that guard to become a precondition later even though it is not one now.
